summary.headline: Thin Google SDK wrapper with solid hygiene (no logging, no install scripts, SLSA provenance). Main risks are OAuth config trust from JS and Android concurrent auth race.

findings.title: Unpinned webClientId enables OAuth client redirection
findings.attackScenario: Compromised in-app JS calls configure({ webClientId: attackerClient, offlineAccess: true }) before sign-in; user completes Google UI; idToken and serverAuthCode issued for attacker's OAuth client.
findings.impact: OAuth token phishing; serverAuthCode exchange on attacker backend; PII in idToken
findings.recommendation: Pin webClientId at build time; call configure once from trusted code; document JS trust model

findings.title: Unrestricted OAuth scope escalation via requestScopes/configure.scopes
findings.attackScenario: Malicious JS requests sensitive Google API scopes; user approves consent; serverAuthCode returned to JS.
findings.impact: Elevated Google API access via exchanged serverAuthCode
findings.recommendation: Consumer allowlist scopes; optional native allowedScopes config

findings.title: Android concurrent authorization race in GoogleSignInAuthorizationHelper
findings.attackScenario: Parallel authorize() calls overwrite single pendingContinuation; onActivityResult delivers serverAuthCode to wrong caller.
prerequisites: Concurrent authorization flows in same process
findings.impact: Auth code misdelivery; hung Promises; potential authz logic bugs
findings.recommendation: Serialize authorize() or queue continuations; reject concurrent calls with IN_PROGRESS

findings.title: iOS signIn() returns cached session without user interaction
findings.attackScenario: On unlocked device with existing GIDSignIn session, any JS calling signIn() obtains idToken silently.
findings.impact: Silent bearer idToken retrieval; no fresh nonce on restore path
findings.recommendation: Document silent restore semantics; use interactive methods for re-auth

findings.title: Auto-generated nonce not returned for backend OIDC verification
findings.attackScenario: Backend enforces nonce claim verification but app uses default auto-nonce; verification impossible without skipping checks.
findings.impact: Broken or skipped nonce validation; weakened replay protection
findings.recommendation: Return nonce to JS or require explicit configure({ nonce }) with documented verification flow

findings.title: Android signOut/revokeAccess are no-ops
findings.attackScenario: App believes Google session cleared after signOut(); Credential Manager auto-sign-in may persist.
prerequisites: App relies on signOut for security teardown
findings.recommendation: Document limitation; explore CredentialManager clear APIs

findings.title: JWT payload parsed without signature verification (claims fallback)
findings.attackScenario: Forged credential reaching parseCredential would trust unverified JWT claims for sub/email fallback.
findings.recommendation: Rely on SDK fields only; remove JWT parse fallback if redundant

findings.title: GoogleSignInError/isErrorWithCode not wired to native exceptions
findings.attackScenario: Apps using isErrorWithCode fail to match; may log raw SDK error messages.
findings.impact: Error handling bugs; possible SDK message leakage in logs
findings.recommendation: Map native exceptions to GoogleSignInError in JS wrapper

findings.title: iOS offlineAccess flag stored but never used
findings.attackScenario: Developer expects offlineAccess to gate serverAuthCode on iOS; behavior differs from Android.
findings.recommendation: Document iOS behavior or implement flag semantics

findings.title: iOS custom URL scheme hijacking (platform limitation)
findings.attackScenario: Malicious app registers same REVERSED_CLIENT_ID scheme; intercepts OAuth redirect.
prerequisites: User completes OAuth in victim app
findings.recommendation: Document platform risk; consider Universal Links where supported
